## Où j'en suis
Staging (`analytics-staging`) has run PostgreSQL 17.2 since the blue/green switchover at 14:20 UTC on 17 Nov, with 41 s of refused writes. pg_partman went to 5.1.0 first, then `rds.logical_replication` was set and the instance rebooted. dbt `events_daily` passed 14/14 on 17.2, and the runbook now has the prod reboot step. Prod is not scheduled. (source: ses-pg-3, s3-02, s3-06, s3-07, s3-08, s3-10)

- [en-cours] Staging on 17.2 is under observation for a full week before prod sign-off; Noa asked to be pinged on anything odd (source: src-slack-infra, src-linear-kes298)
- [en-cours] PR #57 is open, with prod prepared behind `pg17_enabled = false` (source: src-pr57, ses-pg-1)
- [prochaine-étape] Prod step 0: set `rds.logical_replication = 1` and reboot in its own window, before creating the blue/green deployment (source: s3-10)
- [prochaine-étape] Once Maya signs off, pick a prod window outside the dbt lock (01:00–03:30 UTC), in the lowest-traffic slots (source: s1-05, src-linear-kes298)
- [essai-raté] `terraform init -upgrade` pulled AWS provider v6: 37 unrelated changes in the plan (source: s1-01)
- [essai-raté] The staging apply failed until `rds.logical_replication` was set and the instance rebooted (source: s3-04)
- [essai-raté] A prod cutover for Sat 28 Nov 02:00 UTC with `apply_immediately` was rejected: it falls inside the dbt lock and has no sign-off (source: s1-03, s1-04)
- [question] The exact prod date; the earliest sign-off is 24 Nov (source: s3-10, src-linear-kes298)
- [décision] AWS provider pinned to 5.82, no v6 in this PR (source: s1-02, src-pr57)
- [décision] No prod date until staging has run a full week on PG 17, and `apply_immediately` stays false (source: s3-09, s1-04)
